n: First version: log each sickness with first and last sick day, type, symptoms, severity, days off work, doctor visit, medication and notes
“I’m sick” starts an open sickness from today; “I’m well again” closes it
History with search and type filter, statistics per year, month, type and symptom, and a calendar with one year at a glance
Your own lists of sickness types and symptoms, colour themes, light and dark mode
Backup file to save and restore everything, CSV export for spreadsheets
Everything is stored on the phone only
